comment: Local ComfyUI capability manifest (ADR-060). cost_per_second_usd is a KNOWN 0.0 — a local render has no provider charge (distinct from an omitted/unknown estimate; the cost gate still treats MISSING as unknown, never 0). Every entry is documented-best-effort until a maintainer captures a smoke trace against a real containerized ComfyUI — verified:false entries MUST NOT be trusted for planning-critical decisions without surfacing the flag. The template field names the package-shipped workflow under lib/comfyui-templates/ — operator-supplied workflow JSONs are rejected (ADR-060 §3).

wan22-ti2v-5b.label: Wan2.2 TI2V-5B (Apache-2.0) — local text/image-to-video, default template
